cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fake the Expertise
cards.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll get your boiler running. I know these controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've been adjusting the kitchen timer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Establishing the heating interval. Call the engineer; I'll need someone on the boiler.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He asks what temperature you measured.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him we're still establishing the baseline. Put him on speaker; I'll ask the questions so he can concentrate on readings.

mechanism: A covers an obvious heating-control mistake by confidently correcting how B relays questions from the real engineer, preserving A performed expertise.
confusable: Genuine competence would measure the boiler; here the timer mistake exposes fakery and A redirects the expert rather than admits ignorance.
comparison: Violin alternative disguises damage as testing; boiler alternative controls communication to evade measurement.
seedUse: Kitchen-timer and engineer seeds derive from D18-a; S03 turns deflection into increasingly strained correction of the investigation sequence.
